beats.label: S1 · Isla inherits the Waves
beats.text: When Cam enters rehab for drug abuse, he names sister Isla as his successor as president of the family basketball team, over their brothers Ness and Sandy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the power structure the entire series runs on and the resentment that fuels Cam later.

beats.label: S1 · A secret half-brother
beats.text: The Gordons learn Jack fathered an illegitimate son, Jackie Moreno, a concessions worker whose mother just died. Isla hires him as her assistant.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Jackie, who becomes a permanent Gordon and a fixture of the family power base.

beats.label: S1 · Isla proves she can run it
beats.text: Isla saves the team from a sponsor collapse by landing Sephora, defeating Ness and Sandy's no-confidence vote and legitimising her as president.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cements Isla's authority against her brothers, the baseline every future coup measures against.

beats.label: S1 · Cam leaks from rehab
beats.text: A rumour that Marcus is being traded nearly torches the season. Isla clears her brothers, unaware Cam himself is the source, sabotaging her from inside rehab.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals Cam as the hidden antagonist and seeds his return as a threat, not an ally.

beats.label: S1 · Travis's addiction surfaces
beats.text: Marcus and Dyson discover star point guard Travis is abusing his knee medication, a secret Isla will have to weigh against a playoff run.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the ethical choice that defines Isla as president and costs her personally.

beats.label: S1 · Isla chooses the job
beats.text: Isla drives Travis to rehab mid-playoffs and misses Lev's award ceremony. Lev ends the engagement, telling her the team comes first.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends Isla's stabilising personal relationship and clears the field for Jay.

beats.label: S1 · A kiss, and Cam returns
beats.text: The Waves lose game seven on a half-court miracle. Isla and Boston coach Jay share a confused kiss, and the next morning Cam walks back in to reclaim his desk.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The two threads season two opens on: Jay as a romantic complication and Cam as an internal rival.

cliffhanger.text: The Waves fell one game short of the finals. Cam is back in the office intending to retake the presidency, and Isla has just kissed a rival team's coach.
questions: Will Cam succeed in wresting the team back from Isla?
Is Isla's kiss with Jay a fling or the start of something?
Can Isla find a new head coach and hold the roster together for a real title run?

characters.name: Isla Gordon
characters.line: The reformed party-girl now running the Waves; broke up with Lev, on shaky new ground with Jay, and about to defend her chair from her older brother.

characters.name: Cam Gordon
characters.line: The former president, freshly out of rehab and quietly hostile — he leaked on Isla from inside and has returned to take his job back.

characters.name: Ness Gordon
characters.line: The middle brother, married to Bituin; tried to unseat Isla early but has since fallen in line as a working executive.

characters.name: Sandy Gordon
characters.line: The youngest brother, recently back together with boyfriend Charlie after a rough breakup; loyal to Isla in practice.

characters.name: Jackie Moreno
characters.line: Jack's illegitimate son, now Isla's assistant and the family's newest, most eager member.

characters.name: Ali
characters.line: Isla's right-hand executive and closest work confidante, the family whisperer who mentors Jackie.

characters.name: Marcus
characters.line: The Waves' veteran captain and locker-room leader; helped cover for Travis and trusts Isla after she put a player's safety over a game.

characters.name: Travis Bugg
characters.line: The talented, volatile point guard whose painkiller abuse Isla quietly sent to rehab mid-playoffs.

characters.name: Jay
characters.line: The Waves' head coach who signed a deal to leave for Boston at season's end; kissed Isla after the loss.

characters.name: Lev
characters.line: Isla's ex-fiancé, a pediatrician who ended things after she chose the team over him.

beats.label: S2 · Cam back, Norm hired
beats.text: With Cam quietly plotting a return, Isla passes on his coaching pick and hires eccentric former Waves coach Norm Stinson off the strength of a stray notebook.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's central rivalry: Isla's authority vs. Cam's shadow campaign to retake the chair.

beats.label: S2 · Cam's secret sponsor
beats.text: Sandy discovers Cam embezzled from the team and forged his signature to leave rehab early, and that he is not actually sober. The family does not yet know.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The buried crime that will eventually be the only thing strong enough to stop Cam's coup.

beats.label: S2 · Isla can't marry Lev
beats.text: Days before the wedding, and rattled by Jay's presence in town, Isla tells Lev at the rehearsal dinner she cannot go through with it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Frees Isla romantically and reframes Jay from a mistake into a real option.

beats.label: S2 · The stadium collapses
beats.text: The arena ceiling caves in mid-game. Broke and out of options, Isla takes money from season-ticket holder Al to fund the repairs.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Al buying in is the mechanism by which Cam gets the votes for his coup.

beats.label: S2 · Al buys the board
beats.text: After a family basketball game against the McShays and a night with Jay, Isla learns Al has bought out Stephen and other shareholders and now controls the board with Cam.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The coup lands; everything after is Isla scrambling to survive it.

beats.label: S2 · Cam ousted, Waves win it
beats.text: Ness, Sandy and Jackie help expose Cam's embezzlement and drug relapse to the board, killing his coup. Marcus plays through injury and the Waves win the title, then he retires.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the internal war and empties the captain's chair on the roster in one stroke.

beats.label: S2 · Cam and Al build a rival
beats.text: The morning after the championship, the Gordons learn Cam and Al have bought a second LA franchise and hired Jay away as its coach.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The new external antagonist, and it turns Isla's love interest into her direct competitor.

cliffhanger.text: The Waves are champions and Marcus has retired. Cam and Al have bought a rival LA team and poached Jay as its head coach, turning Isla's ex-rival, ex-lover and ousted brother into a single opposing front office.
questions: Can the Waves replace Marcus and repeat as champions?
How does Isla compete against a team run by her own brother and coached by the man she loves?
Will Ness, Ali and Jackie's European scouting trip find the next franchise player?

characters.name: Isla Gordon
characters.line: Reigning champion president, single after calling off Lev, involved with Jay but now facing him across the league.

characters.name: Cam Gordon
characters.line: Exposed as an embezzler and unsober, thrown out of the Waves, and immediately co-owner of a rival LA franchise.

characters.name: Al
characters.line: The wealthy season-ticket holder who bankrolled the stadium repair, bought out the board, and has now bankrolled Cam's rival team.

characters.name: Jay
characters.line: Formerly Boston's coach and Isla's lover; has taken the head coach job at Cam and Al's new LA franchise.

characters.name: Ness Gordon
characters.line: The scouting brain of the family, off to Europe with Ali and Jackie to find a Marcus replacement.

characters.name: Sandy Gordon
characters.line: Broke up with Charlie, quietly dating new star point guard Tommy, and the one who first uncovered Cam's embezzlement.

characters.name: Jackie Moreno
characters.line: Now a trusted Gordon; helped bring down Cam and chose the scouting trip over his girlfriend Sofia.

characters.name: Ali
characters.line: Back from a brief defection to Toronto, restored as Isla's right hand and the only person outside the siblings who knows about her and Jay.

characters.name: Marcus
characters.line: Won the title on a torn meniscus and immediately retired — the Waves' leader and best player is gone.

characters.name: Norm Stinson
characters.line: The oddball veteran coach Isla hired over Cam's objections, now a title-winning head coach.

characters.name: Tommy White
characters.line: The promising new point guard Ness landed to replace Travis; secretly seeing Sandy.
